title: Office Tuna and Egg Lunch
description: A quick, high-protein lunch featuring canned tuna and soft-boiled eggs, perfect for a busy workday.
steps: Drain the tuna into a bowl.
Add the peeled eight-minute eggs to the bowl.
Use a fork to mush the tuna and eggs together.
Add Dijon mustard, red wine vinegar, a drizzle of oil, a squeeze of lemon, garlic, and seasonings to taste.
Mash everything together until well combined.
Serve on top of a sliced tomato with a little extra salt.
notes:
This is a great high-protein meal that is easy to assemble at the office.
